points: Hot path is estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 in geometry_core/src/pipeline_v3_2.cpp: every admitted detection always runs two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 (coarse then fine), and unless the free chamfer cost is at or below about 6.2 mm (lambda_eff = prior_lambda * (1 - confidence) drops to lambda_floor 0.05) it also runs two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior. Default grids are coarse 21 theta x 31 x 31 = 20181 hypotheses (dx/dy +/-0.15 m at 0.01 m, dtheta +/-10 deg at 1 deg), fine 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 (+/-0.012 m at 0.001 m, +/-1.2 deg at 0.2 deg), prior coarse 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 (+/-0.10 m at the same 0.01 m / 1 deg steps) plus the same fine grid, about 4.6e4 bilinear costs when the prior runs. OpenMP parallelizes the flattened (theta, y, x) loop in coarse_chamfer_search_v2 and coarse_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior. Published tx/ty/tz are the bbox-centre ray-plane hit (ray_plane_intersect_cross_camera + apply_se3) and yaw is yaw_from_normal_camera of the plane normal; chamfer theta and translation are stored only in debug. The inlier-face width/height/depth pass is one O(n_inliers) loop after that search.

Each chamfer hypothesis is O(N log N) with a full copy: chamfer_cost_from_rotated assigns tls.translated = rotated (N x 2 Eigen copy) then sample_bilinear_into walks every prototype point, and trimmed_mean_from_distances copies distances into a std::vector and std::sorts all N before a 10% trimmed mean. rotate_proto_into (proto * R^T) is cached once per theta in thread-local storage. The cached prototype (contour_spacing_m 0.03 on a 1.20 x 0.14 outer rectangle plus two 0.47 x 0.10 pockets) is about 182 points, so the sort and the translated-matrix copy repeat on every hypothesis.

The distance image sampled by that search is built once per detection at resolution_m 0.005 with padding_m 0.80 on every side, so rasterize_points_to_mask allocates about (face extent + 1.6 m) / 0.005 pixels. close_mask clones that mask, runs an elliptical morphology close, and connectedComponentsWithStats to keep the largest blob. compute_distance_transform_v2 builds another compare image and calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE, then convertTo a second CV_32FC1 mat. That precise OpenCV distance transform is the main one-shot image cost; every later hypothesis random-accesses the float image.

sample_face_points scans the entire depth image, not the bbox: OpenMP over rows, per pixel Eigen K_inv * (u, v, 1) * z, apply_se3 into the RGB camera, project_pinhole, then a mask test, using cv::Mat::at<float>. Accepted points land in per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets and are copied again row-by-row into an Eigen matrix. build_bbox_mask allocates a full RGB-resolution zero mask and erodes it (erode_px 2). depth_image_to_meters convertTo's a full CV_32FC1 copy once per synced pair; PalletPoseNode repeats the whole estimate for each admitted detection (max_stage2 default 2) on that shared depth mat.

ransac_plane_fit is up to 100 iterations (early stop at inlier ratio 0.85). Each iteration allocates a residual ArrayXd and a bool mask over all face points, O(iters * N). Inliers are copied into a new matrix for JacobiSVD refit. The pipeline then calls plane_inlier_mask again and copies inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates both a centred rel matrix and the 2D result; estimate_pca_long_axis allocates another centred copy for a 2x2 covariance. These Eigen copies are O(N) and sit well below the chamfer grids.

Stage-1 inference is RtDetrDetector.detect: image_to_rgb copies the ROS buffer via bytes(msg.data) and a contiguous RGB array (channel reverse for bgr8; mono8 repeats the gray plane three times), preprocess cv2.resize to 640x640 with INTER_LINEAR (no letterbox), astype float32, transpose to CHW, divide by 255, and ascontiguousarray a (1, 3, 640, 640) batch. TensorRTBackend.infer (tensorrt + pycuda; default node backend is mock) astype/copyto's images and orig_target_sizes into pagelocked host buffers, memcpy_htod_async, execute_async_v3 or execute_async_v2, synchronizes, and .copy()s labels, boxes, and scores back. Postprocess is a score filter and argsort of the engine's top-k, not NMS. The pose node only runs after message_filters sync of that detection array with depth.
